message.content: {"A0100":"To obtain and sustain firing geometry on B0100, A0100 most plausibly uses a hard descending left turn to collapse their separation, expends its last missile once the geometry develops, and then steadies on a westward pursuit course as its missile bends toward the still-active opponent.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to deny the pursuing B0100 missile an intercept by maintaining high speed while arcing left toward north-northeast, thereby opening northward separation from B0100; the missile remains behind to the west and follows the turn, while A0200 neither fires nor becomes inactive."}

answers.A0100: To obtain and sustain firing geometry on B0100, A0100 most plausibly uses a hard descending left turn to collapse their separation, expends its last missile once the geometry develops, and then steadies on a westward pursuit course as its missile bends toward the still-active opponent.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to deny the pursuing B0100 missile an intercept by maintaining high speed while arcing left toward north-northeast, thereby opening northward separation from B0100; the missile remains behind to the west and follows the turn, while A0200 neither fires nor becomes inactive.
